version_scope: BTP — confirm current capability framing dates vs legacy pillar marketing

claims.text: Earlier BTP marketing used a small set of capability pillars (historically framed around areas such as database/data management, application development, integration, analytics, and related platform themes). Treat any fixed '5-pillar' inventory as dated marketing unless a dated SAP source for the interview context is attached.

For security-focused BTP questions, cover: global account / directory / subaccount structure; identity trust with Cloud Identity (IAS); role templates; role collections; XSUAA (Authorization and Trust Management); destinations and connectivity including Cloud Connector; audit logging. Mention OAuth, mTLS, or principal propagation only when a source supports the claim for the scenario.

sources.section: SAP BTP security / Authorization and Trust Management / Cloud Connector (verify)

notes: Depth checklist for security-focused asks; not every BTP question requires the full security set.
